name: phmsa-pipeline-penalty-reduction
description: Will a PHMSA Notice of Probable Violation with a proposed civil penalty be closed within 36 months with a lower assessed penalty than proposed?
split_description: Fixed chronological boundaries by Notice_Sent_Date: train 2002-01-01 to 2016-12-31; evaluation 2017-01-01 to 2019-12-31; holdout 2020-01-01 to 2023-06-30. No embargo is needed because no lagged outcomes, rolling histories, operator histories, or future case records are used; related cases are deduplicated by WMS_Activity_Seq before splitting.
